title: Local or global?

pick.code:
x = 5
def f():
    x = 10
    return x
f()
print(x)

x = 5
def f():
    return x + 1
print(f())

x = 5
def f():
    global x
    x = 10
f()
print(x)

statement:
What does this program print?

```python
[$c.code]
```

Type it exactly as Python prints it.

[______________]{a}
hints: Is x assigned inside the function?
Assignment makes a local unless declared global.
solution:
A local x doesn't change the global one (unless `global x`).

It prints `[$c.out]`.
